name: New chat
tip: Find a person and start a direct conversation.

children.name: finduser
children.empty:
Type a name, callsign, npub, LXMF address or identity hash.
NomadNet peers heard on the mesh appear as you type; a pasted LXMF address works even before they announce.
children.tip: Tap a person to start the conversation. NomadNet peers chat here over LXMF; Geogram people open in Messages.

name: Settings
tip: Station identity, position, Bluetooth and media.

children.name: position
children.tip: Your position and how far around it to listen.

children.name: bluetooth
children.tip: Exchange short messages directly over Bluetooth, off-grid.

children.name: ble_enabled
children.label: Exchange over Bluetooth
children.tip: Scan for and broadcast chat frames over BLE.

children.name: channels
children.tip: Which broadcast channels this device listens to. Rooms are always on; these are the open firehoses.

children.name: chan_local
children.label: Local chat (nearby devices)
children.tip: Group chatter from devices around you, over Bluetooth and local Reticulum. Off = those channels leave the rail and stop counting as unread.

children.name: chan_global
children.label: Global chat (internet Reticulum)
children.tip: Worldwide group channels relayed by internet Reticulum nodes. Off = the worldwide firehose disappears from the rail.

children.name: chan_nomad
children.label: NomadNet bridge (#NOMADNET)
children.tip: Messages from non-geogram NomadNet/LXMF nodes. Off = they are dropped on arrival.

children.name: media
children.tip: Images shared in messages are fetched over the network.

children.name: media_auto_mb
children.label: Auto-download images up to (MB)
children.tip: Images at or below this size download automatically.

children.name: identity_broadcast
children.tip: Periodically broadcast your public key so others can message you encrypted.

children.name: pubkey_beacon
children.label: Broadcast my public key
children.tip: Every 30 min, send your profile's public key as a bulletin so peers can message you encrypted.

children.name: pubkey_apply
children.label: Apply key broadcast
children.tip: Save the setting above and send one broadcast now.
